name: Electronic Funds Transfer (NIP)
explanation: A transaction fee charged by your bank when you transfer money electronically to another person's bank account. The amount depends on how much money you're sending.

name: USSD Charges
amount: Varies - same as NIP transfer charges currently apply
explanation: Fees charged when you use USSD codes (like *737#, *901#, etc.) to access banking services on your phone without internet.

name: ATM withdrawal from another bank
amount: Free for first 3 withdrawals monthly, ₦35-100 after that
explanation: A fee charged when you withdraw cash from an ATM that doesn't belong to your bank. You get free withdrawals from other banks per month (usually 3), then charges apply after that.

name: ATM withdrawal from your own bank
explanation: No fee charged when you withdraw cash from your own bank's ATM. This is always completely free.

name: Card issuance/renewal/replacement fee
explanation: A one-time fee charged when your debit or credit card is first issued, renewed after expiration, or replaced due to damage or loss.

name: Card maintenance fee (savings account)
explanation: A quarterly fee charged to keep your savings account card active. Cards linked to current accounts are not charged this fee.

name: Current Account Maintenance Fee (CAMF)
explanation: A fee charged only on current accounts based on customer-initiated debit transactions. Not applicable to savings accounts.

name: SMS Alert Fee
explanation: A mandatory charge for transaction SMS notifications, regulated by NCC and CBN. Recently increased from ₦4 to ₦6 per alert.

name: Stamp Duty / EMTL
explanation: A government tax charged on electronic transfers of ₦10,000 and above, borne by the sender. Mandatory under the Tax Act effective January 2026.

name: VAT (Value Added Tax)
explanation: A tax applied on top of certain bank service charges, such as card fees and SMS alerts, where those charges are classified as taxable banking services.

name: Cashless Policy Charge
amount: 2% on deposits above ₦500,000, 3% on withdrawals above ₦500,000
explanation: Charges applied under Nigeria's cashless policy for large cash transactions, designed to encourage digital banking.
